# greeting skill
Use this skill to greet users in a friendly manner. The bot can respond to greetings such as "hello", "hi", "hey", and "good morning" with appropriate responses.

## workflow
1. Run the script located at `.github/skills/greeting/scripts/get-system-info.js` to obtain system information such as platform, architecture, type, and release.

2. Respond with [Template](./TEMPLATE.md) in ascii art.

3. Provide the system information obtained from the script.
